description: Claude Code 2.1.323 passes `agent_id` and `agent_type` to PreCompact, PostCompact and the post-compaction SessionStart hook when a subagent compacts. extras/claude-code/hooks/hooks.json reports `--compacting` on PreCompact and `compacted-in` on PostCompact without checking `agent_id`, so a subagent compacting should mark the pane compacting (inferred from the hook text, not yet observed). The PostToolUse hooks already skip input carrying `agent_id`; do the same here. From tooling feedback a_30soVTf5Z.
title: A subagent's compaction marks the whole Claude Code pane compacting
